template.description: The template to merge this input over (Merging a template). None when absent.

job.description: Job name to reserve; the template's when absent, else none.

cwd.description: Absolute directory to start in. Absent: the template's, else the caller's working directory when the input came from flags (Caller context). Required after merging.

type.description: Where to open it: a new tab in the caller's OS window, a split of the caller's tab, or a new OS window. Each backend maps these to its own terms (kitty: tab, window, os-window; iTerm2: a tab, a vertical split of the caller's pane, a window). Absent: the template's, else tab (the default applies after merging).

name.description: The session's name: passed to claude as --name, and the tab title. Absent: the template's, else the merged job; with neither, claude's own name and the backend's own title.

prompt.description: First prompt, passed to claude as its last argument, after --. Replaces the template's prompt, whole.

args.description: Extra claude arguments, passed in order before the prompt, after the template's.

vars.description: The new window's user variables (in kitty, --var; in iTerm2, user.<name> variables): for matching windows, not environment variables. Merged over the template's, this input's value winning per key. A terminal backend without user variables refuses any.

extra.description: The session's user-owned extra (design-spec User-owned extra), handed over in the reservation. None when absent: the session starts with {}. A template can't give one.

start_timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for the session to start. 0 returns as soon as the window is open. Absent: the template's, else 15 (the default applies after merging).
